shortlist_rationale: Original nnPU and three promising local tree families; local-test-informed shortlist, external outcomes unseen
source_switch: Broad Figshare API, page and direct downloads returned HTTP 403; use official Sanger public Project Score archive instead
gene_scope: Unique unversioned Ensembl matches; only previously unlabelled genes in primary analysis
model_scope: Pancreatic adenocarcinoma models with screened data; exclude PANC1/HPNE and their known donor-matched models; collapse models from same donor
common_essential_policy: Exclude genes annotated common essential or pan-cancer core fitness by the source in primary analysis; include in secondary sensitivity
primary_endpoint: Spearman correlation of frozen model score with negative median pancreatic fitness, among eligible unlabelled non-common-essential genes
direction: Higher model scores should correlate with stronger depletion (more negative source fitness)
multiplicity: Holm adjustment across four primary one-sided rank-correlation permutation p-values
secondary_endpoints: Top 100 and top 500 median fitness and random-gene-set enrichment
Correlation with pancreatic selectivity: median other-lineage fitness minus median pancreatic fitness
All measured genes and known-positive controls as explicitly secondary analyses
inference_limit: Orthogonal functional evidence, not a test of all cancer driver mechanisms or clinical prediction; no external-data tuning or retraining
status: Frozen before measurement inspection; exact file schema and metadata cohort to be audited before evaluation
